title: Code and tables for: Could seismic waves from the 1992 Lop Nor nuclear explosion have revealed a pyramid buried in Alaska?
description: Analysis code and the tables behind every number of a Seismica Report that tests whether recordings of the 21 May 1992 Lop Nor nuclear explosion could have revealed a pyramid buried in Alaska: station coverage of the time, coda levels of regional records, three-dimensional simulations of P scattered into Rayleigh waves by a compact shallow body, and the array method.
